g.text: Regional progress hides different arrival times
Countries ever observed at the milestone (%)
Fixed panel of 158 classified countries; one unclassified country excluded. Annual observations, equal country weights.
First attainment persists in this count even if adoption later falls. Already above in 2000 may have crossed earlier; others may cross after 2020.
